programme.title: Boreale, Vivencias De Un Guía De Caza T6 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Javi Urbano se desplaza hasta la serranía de Cuenca para recechar distintas especies. El coto ubicado muy cerca del parque del Hosquillo, cuenta con ciervos, muflones, jabalíes y algo de macho montés.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Acompanhamos o Víctor, um pescador experiente e peculiar de predadores, na sua aventura na barragem de Buendía, uma das enormes barragens clássicas do mar de Castela, onde podem surgir várias espécies predadoras. Desde lúcio, passando por black bass, perca-americana e também a perca-europeia.

programme.title: As Carpas De Jose
programme.desc: La Majua es un pequeño municipio de la comarca de Babia, buen ejemplo del salvajismo y belleza de la montaña occidental leonesa. Muy cercano a las Ubiñas, estamos ante un terreno rico en caza mayor, siendo destacable como cazadero de rebecos, convirtiendo a las batidas del jabalí en caza extrema.

programme.title: Play Caza T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Viajamos a las montañas leonesas con los hermanos Lestrade, que decidieron celebrar el 80 aniversario de Michel cazando un rebeco cantábrico y descubriendo las bondades de la cocina montañesa.

programme.title: Caçadores De Javalis T6 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: La pesca en los estuarios donde se mezcla el agua dulce con la salada se convierte en esta serie, en todo un reto para la pesca. Desde kayak o desde orilla, con lluvia o al final del verano, nuestros protagonistas nos mostrarán las mejores técnicas y las localizaciones más oportunas para disfrutar de las especies deportivas del litoral gallego.

programme.title: Cozinha Selvagem Com Diego Gallegos T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Una familia extremeña, gran aficionada a la caza menor sube de forma habitual todos los años a las ya famosas tiradas de palomas en la provincia de Madrid.

programme.title: Marqués De Valdueza: Legado Montero
programme.desc: Guardamar é um dos destinos favoritos dos amantes da pesca. Perto das suas costas, os atum fazem as suas migrações e José, Hilario e António aproveitam os dias para as tentar pescar a spinning a partir de uma embarcação. Uma pesca muito ativa que não deixa ninguém indiferente.

programme.title: Spinning En Estuarios Gallegos T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Segunda parte de la monteria celebrada en el Coto Nieblas donde 11 monteros ubicados en torretas disfrutaron de los lances a venados, gamos, muflones y jabalies.

programme.title: Recechando Después De La Berrea
programme.desc: Através de um dos criadores mais reconhecidos de podengos manetos vamos conhecer esta pequena mas grande raça para a caça ao coelho. Estes apaixonados pela espécie souberam aliar beleza e trabalho nas suas linhas conseguindo grandes trunfos quer na competição de beleza como a caçar no campo com os seus exemplares.

programme.title: Predadores Em Buendía.
programme.desc: De la mano del Campeón Mundial de Pesca a Mosca, David Arcay, vamos a conocer la Galicia más auténtica en los entornos de los ríos más representativos de esta fantástica región del norte. David, pescando a mosca y a ninfa, nos mostrará cuál es el estado actual de las diferentes especies, sobresaliendo entre ellas una trucha esquiva, fuerte y sobre todo combativa.

programme.desc: Unos de los aspectos más importantes en un perro de muestra son la guia y la muestra. Para ello son precisos los trucos que nuestro maestro, el adiestrador Manuel de la Iglesia, nos proporciona en este capítulo.

programme.desc: El coto de Viana do Bolo se encuentra en la provincia de Orense, muy cerca de la frontera con Portugal y de las provincias de León y Zamora. Con grandes montes de castaño y roble el jabalí tiene asegurada la comida, permitiendo grandes batidas con muy buenos resultados.

programme.desc: Deslocámo-nos para a zona da Aceitera e das lajes de Conil para praticar pesca subaquática numa das zonas mais ricas em peixe, mas também mais perigosa devido às correntes do Estreito. Um dia de pesca subaquática apaixonante.

programme.title: Berreia En Boñar
programme.desc: Mario se desplaza hasta la cordillera pirenaica en busca de diferentes especies.La caza y la gastronomía vuelven a ir de la mano.

programme.title: La Aceitera, Contra Corrente
programme.desc: En este capítulo de Carnaza nos visita Gerard Calvet, un chico que, como bien, dice no sabe freír un huevo frito y que nunca ha probado la carne de caza. ¿Le gustara? Junto a Iban aprenderá a cocinar una receta con carne de gamo fácil e ideal para iniciarse en la cocina cinegética.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: En este ultimo capitulo, nuestro experto arquero nos enseña como fabricar uno de los elementos más importantes para apuntar bien. El loop.

programme.title: Carnaza T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Situado a sul dos Picos de Europa, as montanhas leonesas de Boñar albergam uma extraordinária diversidade de fauna incluindo espécies tão emblemáticas como o lobo ou o urogallo. Neste episódio. vamos viver, na companhia de jovens caçadores a caça ao veado na berreira, um espetáculo da natureza onde os grandes veados lutam para perpetuar a espécie.

Caza menor con perros de grouses o pequeños urogallos, o en puestos de patos, barnaclas o gansos blancos.

programme.title: Caça Maior - Ep. 286

programme.title: Wild Menor - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O futuro da galinhola.

programme.title: Blaser F16, O Equilíbrio Perfeito - Ep. 3

programme.title: Brama Zamorana - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A pausa. Brama zamorana é a emocionante crónica da vibrante caça ao veado ibérico através das experiências de sete caçadores diferentes. Um espetáculo de sons e emoções vivido a partir do interior, repleto de lances frenéticos com carabina e arco ao ritmo dos bramidos que invadem a floresta. Apreciar as demonstrações de poder e os rituais de lutas dos poderosos machos que se tornarão nos objetivos das nossas aproximações.

programme.title: Coelhos - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Coelhos com ibicencos. Saltos e abates, quebras e paragens, silvas e tocas, cães e furões. Um elenco completo de possibilidades para desfrutar da caça ao coelho no Cazavisión. Admirar a astúcia do coelho para evitar ser caçado, contemplar a sua agilidade e o instinto dos cães para os mostrar, ou apanhá-los.

programme.title: A Arte Da Caça Do Veado - Ep. 195
programme.desc: De tempos a tempos. A arte da caça do veado chega ao Cazavisión. Três aventuras com um denominador comum, a caça ao veado. Tentaremos alcançar o grande rei coroado através da caça de batidas na montanha, na brama, e dos menos tradicionais, mas não por isso menos interessante, com aguardos. Veados, portanto, para todos os gostos e em todos os tipos de cenários.

programme.title: Vamos A Uma Montaria - Ep. 397

programme.title: O Especialista
programme.desc: Uma mulher convence o especialista em explosivos com quem anda envolvida a destruir o império criminoso que lhe matou a família.

programme.title: Corrida Mortal: Inferno
programme.desc: O assassino de polícias Carl Lucas, também conhecido por Frankenstein, é uma super-estrela da condução na brutal corrida da prisão conhecida como Death Race. Para conquistar a Liberdade, terá de ganhar uma corrida brutal, pelos desertos da África do Sul.

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 3
programme.desc: Quando a filha de um magnata da tecnologia de Hong Kong é atirada para uma prisão de segurança máxima na Letónia, o especialista em segurança Ray Breslin é contratado para resgatá-la. Só que a namorada dele também é raptada e a missão já de si difícil passa a ser de vida ou de morte.

programme.title: Brimstone - Castigo
programme.desc: No velho Oeste, a jovem muda Liz vive com o marido e os filhos, mas a sua vida vai mudar de forma radical com a chegada de um novo pastor à comunidade, obsessivo e violento, que leva a que ela rapidamente perceba que a sua família vai correr um enorme perigo.

programme.title: O Quadrado
programme.desc: Christian é o respeitado curador de um museu de arte contemporânea de Estocolmo, que tenta montar uma polémica instalação enquanto se encontra numa crise pessoal e profissional.

programme.title: Salve, César!
programme.desc: Nos anos de ouro de Hollywood, Eddie Mannix é o especialista na resolução de problemas de um grande estúdio de cinema, que de repente perde a estrela da sua gigantesca e dispendiosa produção bíblica e tem apenas um dia para a encontrar...

programme.title: After
programme.desc: Tessa, uma rapariga bem-comportada de dezoito anos, conhece na faculdade Hardin, um rapaz rude e rico com um passado sombrio, por quem se apaixona e com o qual perde a virgindade. Os dois embarcam numa relação turbulenta e intensa, que os mudará para sempre.

programme.title: Negócios De Ocasião
programme.desc: O proprietário de uma pequena empresa e os seus dois sócios viajam para a Europa para fecharem o negócio mais importante das suas vidas. Mas o que começou como uma viagem de negócios vai sair fora dos carris, incluindo escalas não programadas…

programme.title: Space Jam: Uma Nova Era
programme.desc: Quando LeBron James e o seu filho Dom são aprisionados numa realidade digital por uma Inteligência Artificial, o campeão da NBA terá de os fazer regressar salvos a casa, liderando Bugs, Lola Bunny e todo o gangue dos Looney Tunes numa vitória num jogo de basquetebol como nunca se viu.

programme.title: Agentes Duplos
programme.desc: Danny Gallagher é um ex-agente da brigada de narcóticos completamente desacreditado que ao sair da prisão se procura vingar de quem o denunciou e lhe matou o parceiro. Pelo caminho, vai cruzar-se com uma sedutora e implacável agente do governo e com o polícia reformado que fora o seu mentor.

programme.title: A Cidade
programme.desc: Douglas “Doug” MacRay é um assaltante que está a planear o próximo golpe mas que tem de lidar com os sentimentos que nutre por Claire, a gerente de um dos bancos que ele outrora assaltou, bem como com o agente do FBI que o quer apanhar e à sua equipa.

programme.title: O Coletivo
programme.desc: Um jovem recruta para uma misteriosa agência de assassinos torna-se um pária na sua primeira missão, rastreando um perigoso grupo de traficantes de pessoas.

programme.title: O Meu Espião
programme.desc: JJ é um experiente agente da CIA, que, depois de uma missão infiltrado, se vê despromovido e controlado por Sophie, uma miúda de nove anos que lhe descobriu o disfarce e o convenceu a ensiná-la a ser uma espia em troca de não o revelar.

programme.title: Causa Justa
programme.desc: Um professor de Direito em Harvard reabre uma investigação de assassínio a pedido de um condenado à morte, que afirma ter sido forçado por um sinistro polícia a confessar um crime que não cometeu.

programme.title: Instinto Predador
programme.desc: Um navio grego transporta animais exóticos perigosos da Amazónia, incluindo um raro jaguar branco. Nessa mesma embarcação, um assassino, que estava a ser extraditado em segredo para os EUA, consegue fugir e libertar todos os animais em cativeiro, deixando os tripulantes em perigo de vida.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: No seu aniversário, Tyler e mais quatro amigos são levados pela namorada dele para um local desconhecido onde são trancados em quartos, dos quais só saem resolvendo vários quebra-cabeças. Só quando o jogo se torna perigoso é que todos eles percebem que algo está muito errado.

programme.title: Faz-te Homem
programme.desc: Quando o milionário James King é condenado à prisão por fraude, o juiz dá-lhe 30 dias para pôr os seus assuntos em ordem e ele pede a Darnell Lewis que o prepare para uma vida atrás das grades. Só que ele não sabe que Darnell é um homem honesto e que vai ter de fingir para o ajudar.

programme.title: Parasitas
programme.desc: Uma família coreana no desemprego começa a ter um interesse peculiar por uma outra, com um estilo de vida cheio de glamour, até que todos se envolvem num acontecimento absolutamente inesperado.

programme.title: Space Jam: Uma Nova Era
programme.desc: Quando LeBron James e o seu filho Dom são aprisionados numa realidade digital por uma Inteligência Artificial, o campeão da NBA terá de os fazer regressar salvos a casa, liderando Bugs, Lola Bunny e todo o gangue dos Looney Tunes numa vitória num jogo de basquetebol como nunca se viu.

programme.title: Negócios De Ocasião
programme.desc: O proprietário de uma pequena empresa e os seus dois sócios viajam para a Europa para fecharem o negócio mais importante das suas vidas. Mas o que começou como uma viagem de negócios vai sair fora dos carris, incluindo escalas não programadas…

programme.title: Balbúrdia No Oeste
programme.desc: Com o objetivo de levar à ruína uma cidade do Oeste para roubar as terras aos locais, um político corrupto nomeia um xerife negro, que ele acha que irá provocar o caos entre os locais, mas que afinal se tornará o maior defensor da população.

programme.title: Extremamente Perverso, Escandalosamente Cruel E Vil
programme.desc: Ted é um homem bonito, inteligente e afetuoso. Liz é uma mãe solteira, cautelosa, mas apaixonada. Imagem da felicidade doméstica, a vida deste casal parece perfeita até ele ser preso e acusado de vários assassínios tenebrosos. Ele é Ted Bundy e torna-se o serial-killer mais famoso da América.

programme.title: Perigo Em Alto Mar
programme.desc: Um grupo de amigos de férias no México rouba duas motas de água numa noite de festa. Demasiada confiança e más decisões levam a um acidente terrível. Perdidos, com um deles ferido e a quilómetros da praia, o terror começa quando se apercebem que foram levados para águas infestadas de tubarões.

programme.title: Snitch - Infiltrado
programme.desc: Com o filho adolescente injustamente acusado de tráfico de droga, John Matthews faz um acordo para trabalhar numa perigosa missão como informador infiltrado junto de traficantes, arriscando tudo, incluindo a família e a própria vida.

programme.title: Hotel Mumbai
programme.desc: Esta é a história do ataque terrorista ao luxuoso Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, em Bombaim, no ano de 2008. No meio do caos, os funcionários do hotel arriscam a vida para manterem todos a salvo e fazem sacrifícios impensáveis para se protegerem a si e às suas famílias.

programme.title: Tom Horn, O Cowboy
programme.desc: Wyoming, início do século XX. Tom Horn, lendário batedor do exército, é contratado por rancheiros para pôr fim aos ladrões de gado. Mas os seus métodos implacáveis tornam-se um incómodo, e os mesmos homens que o contrataram acabam por se voltar contra ele.

programme.title: As Brancas Montanhas Da Morte
programme.desc: Veterano de guerra, Jeremiah Johnson isola-se nas Montanhas Rochosas em busca de paz como caçador solitário. Aí aprende a sobreviver na natureza selvagem e constrói uma família — até a tragédia o transformar numa lenda viva, marcada por uma guerra sem fim contra os índios Crow.

programme.title: O Especialista
programme.desc: Uma mulher convence o especialista em explosivos com quem anda envolvida a destruir o império criminoso que lhe matou a família.

programme.title: Um Ajuste De Contas
programme.desc: Frank é um ex-assassino de um sindicato do crime local que jurou vingar-se contra os chefes da máfia após 19 anos aprisionado por um homicídio que não cometeu. A única coisa que o desvia dos seus violentos planos é o relacionamento que voltou a ter com o seu filho.

programme.title: Nikolai Kapustin - Sinfonietta op. 49 - Overture
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras.

programme.title: Stravinsky, Webern and Debussy
programme.desc: Today’s Brussels Philharmonic concert focuses on the diverse musical styles that characterized the first half of the 20th century. In addition to the impressionism of Claude Debussy's Jeux (1913), conductor Michel Tabachnik's ensemble focuses on one of the leading composers of modern music: Igor Stravinsky. His first ballet music, Firebird (1910), is a highlight of the concert.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz
programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s ‘Der Freischütz’ was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 And 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke Op. 73
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven’s final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano: Mozart, Beethoven a.o.
programme.desc: On the occasion of International Women’s Day, Italian violinist Laura Marzadori and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti performed a wonderful concert at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 18 in G major, K. 301; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Schubert - Winterreise
programme.desc: Baritone Samuel Hasselhorn and pianist Daniel Heide perform Franz Schubert’s song cycle Winterreise (‘Winter’s journey’). The 30-year-old Schubert wrote this masterpiece in 1827, just a year before his death. Like Schubert’s earlier song cycle Die schöne Müllerin (1823), Winterreise is a setting of the poetry of Wilhelm Müller (1794-1827).

programme.title: Hollywood Gala – Awards Night
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in 1986 at the initiative of Claudio Abbado and has since become the world’s best youth orchestra. Named after the great composer, the programme is marked by the special relationship between the maestro and the young orchestra, as well as their special relationship to Gustav Mahler.

programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin’s symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928).

programme.title: B. Strozzi - Sino alla morte
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvorák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, 'From the New World'. Composed during Dvorák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Echoes of San Marco And Fellini
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the Giuseppe Nicolini Conservatory of Piacenza and the Giuseppe Verdi of Milan as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme.” On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. “Echoes of San Marco” is a tribute to the Venetian Renaissance composer Giovanni Gabrieli (1555-1612).

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Sleeping Beauty (2013)
programme.desc: The award-winning Imperial Ice Stars are 26 Olympic, World, European and National Championship skaters, who jointly hold over 250 competition medals, performing theatrical ice dancing on a frozen theatre stage.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform ‘Lust der Sturmnacht’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Le diable dans la nuit’ from Henriëtte Bosmans’ Dix mélodies; Franz Schubert’s Totengräbers Heimweh, D.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Solos for Clarinet, Part I
programme.desc: The great clarinettist Paolo Beltramini plays a program of solo pieces for clarinet on Stingray Brava. In this broadcast, Beltramini performs C.P.E. Bach’s Solfeggietto, Béla Kovàc’s Hommage à Paganini, and Igor Stravinsky’s Three Pieces for Clarinet Solo. Paolo Beltramini is the only Italian clarinettist to have won first prize at the prestigious Prague Spring International Clarinet Competition (1996).

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann wrote Carnaval, Op. 9 in 1834–1835. It consists of 21 short pieces representing masked revelers at Carnival, a festival before Lent.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: The LSO performs Dvorák and Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Antonín Dvorák’s Scherzo Capriccioso in D-flat major, Op. 66, and selections from Act II of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s famous ballet The Nutcracker (1892). Dvorák’s Scherzo Capriccioso (1883) reflects a period of personal crisis for the composer. The work betrays ever-changing moods and a constant sense of inner restlessness.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Live in Aix-en-Provence
programme.desc: The shy and elusive Grigroy Sokolov is one of the greatest pianists of our time. His performances leave critics and audiences alike speechless, like they don't quite believe what they have just experienced. In 2015, he played a beautiful recital with works by Johann Sebastian Bach, Ludwig van Beethoven, Franz Schubert, Frédéric Chopin, and Claude Debussy that took place at the Festival La Roque D'Anthéron in Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 2 BWV 1015
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach probably wrote this set of six Sonatas for Violin and Harpsichord during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Così fan tutte
programme.desc: Maestro Zubin Mehta leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s comic opera Così fan tutte (1790). Following the successful operas Le nozze di Figaro (1786) and Don Giovanni (1787), Così fan tutte was the third and last collaboration between Mozart and the Venetian librettist and poet Lorenzo Da Ponte.

programme.title: Mahler - Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children. The work's emotional depth comes from its unflinching portrayal of grief through a powerful juxtaposition of natural imagery and intimate parental pain.

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T4 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Nas montanhas do Tennessee, os Raneys constroem uma enorme tenda mongol. Transformam um lago abandonado numa fonte de alimentos e criam uma oficina com uma forja a propano.

programme.title: A Minha Família Vive No Alasca T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: O caos abate-se quando as cheias alagam a região, e os Brown têm que equilibrar o destino da sua nova comunidade com o sucesso da sua propriedade.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Ava, uma produtora de moda de Seattle, e Larry, paramédico do Kentucky, estão na hostil selva Maia, no México, onde um susto de saúde atinge o par forte e feio.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Este é o teste final de sobrevivência do mais capaz. O que acontece quando coloca um homem e uma mulher nus numa das zonas mais remotas do mundo?

programme.title: Texas Metal T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Bill puxa pela sua criatividade ao construir o seu próprio Yukon Denali XL 2018. Este luxuoso SUV é a sua maior construção de sempre. Um Suburban de 1970 recebe uma renovação.

programme.title: Texas Metal T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: As habilidades da equipa são esticadas ao máximo quando transforma um Internacional Harvester de 1940 num churrasco móvel. A herança de uma família é modernizada.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T21 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados à lupa para sabermos como são feitos os pneus dos dragters, gelo, docas flutuantes e canos.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T11 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Os mineiros do ouro de Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de enriquecerem da noite para o dia. Com mineiros, reivindicações e máquinas novas, os riscos nunca foram tão grandes!

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T11 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Os mineiros do ouro de Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de enriquecerem da noite para o dia. Com mineiros, reivindicações e máquinas novas, os riscos nunca foram tão grandes!

programme.title: Aquários XXL T8 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: O Mob Museum faz uma oferta a ATM que não podem recusar! Querem um aquário com uma réplica do naufrágio de um navio para a sua exposição na baixa de Las Vegas.

programme.title: Aquários XXL T8 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Uma empresa que cria peças para veículos raros e de luxo quer um aquário com peixes exóticos. Eles querem um tanque grande, com três lados como peça central.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T14 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: As tripulações do Northwestern, Seabrooke, Time Bandit, Wizard, Kodiak e Ramblin 'Rose regressam às perigosas águas geladas do Mar de Bering para mais pesca pesada do caranguejo.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T14 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Sig apressa-se a descarregar os seus tanques antes de perder meio milhão de dólares em caranguejo. A tensão entre co-comandantes atinge um ponto de rutura ao leme do Wizard.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T14 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: É um batismo pelo fogo a bordo do Northewestern quando Mandy faz o seu primeiro turno em mar alto. A tripulação do Wizard lutam por um homem que não está a puxar o seu peso.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T14 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Uma tempestade de superlua épica causa o caos nas marés. A Guarda Costeira tenta uma missão de resgate, enquanto Wild Bill enfrenta o seu pior pesadelo quando um novato cai ao mar.

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Os Raneys chegam a uma propriedade ameaçada pelo calor, coiotes e até vacas. O desastre abate-se quando Marty tenta proteger o gado com uma enorme construção.

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T1 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Os Raynes chegam a uma propriedade cujo dono é obcecado por abelhas e que, involuntariamente, atrai ursos com as suas colmeias. Ventos fortes ameaçam o balneário.

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Os Raneys respondem a um pedido de socorro de um casal que vive longe de tudo. Mas com fortes tempestades ameaçando cheias, correm contra a Mãe Natureza.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio, revelando a sua produção. Como são feitas, por exemplo, as mesas de shuffleboard?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio, revelando a sua produção. Como são feitos objetos como mesas de hóquei de ar?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio, revelando a sua produção. Como são feitos objetos como quadros brancos e pressões de ar?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio, revelando a sua produção. Saiba como são feitos objetos como bretes e propulsores de barcos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio, revelando a sua produção. Como são feitos objetos como saunas retráteis e canivetes?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Veja como são feitos os objetos do quotidiano. Conheça os métodos e materiais usados em coisas banais e os singulares processos de produção envolvidos para as fazer.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Veja como são feitos os objetos do quotidiano. Conheça os métodos e materiais usados em coisas banais e os singulares processos de produção envolvidos para as fazer.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T26 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Saiba como são feitos os objetos do dia-a-dia e conheça os métodos e materiais usados em coisas banais e os singulares processo de produção envolvidos para as fazer.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Quais são os processos de produção por detrás dos extratores de óleos vegetais e cápsulas de café?

programme.title: Bear Grylls - O Sobrevivente T4 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Bear é lançado no mar do Panamá e chega à costa. Constrói uma jangada e destila água salgada para beber. Será que a tempestade afundará o seu barco?

programme.title: Bear Grylls - O Sobrevivente T4 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Bear faz parapente nas Rockies, atravessa cascatas gigantes e navega em ravinas profundas antes de saltar para um comboio em movimento.

programme.title: Bear Grylls - O Sobrevivente T4 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Bear é lançado em território de tufões, onde passa por rios caudalosos e cascatas enormes. As técnicas tribais garantem-lhe morcegos como alimento?

programme.title: Bear Grylls - O Sobrevivente T4 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Bear é largado num vulcão ativo, onde anda por lava e escala grutas. Como é que se evita uma víbora de se aninhar ao nosso lado durante o sono?

programme.title: Bear Grylls - O Sobrevivente T4 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Bear mostra como as técnicas de sobrevivência na natureza podem ser aplicadas numa cidade, onde todos os confortos da vida moderna foram destruídos.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T4 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Juan tem de dar uma aula sobre melhorias de lavadeiras de vaivém para minério para salvar 1,2 milhões de dólares de uma família da Colúmbia Britânica.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro: Minas Perdidas T4 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Com o inverno a aproximar-se, Dave e Lance apostam num distrito mineiro no sopé do Monte Denali. De volta à mina, a equipa bate um recorde em ouro.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro: Minas Perdidas T4 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: O resultado do teste da Covid de Dave é positivo e este delega no mecânico Nathan uma prospeção sozinho. As avarias no equipamento obrigam Andrew, um novato, a assumir o controlo.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro: Minas Perdidas T4 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Dave recebe uma chamada para uma prospeção única no Rancho Gravely, no Montana, onde descobre o melhor terreno com ouro que alguma vez viu nas 48 regiões mais baixas.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro: Minas Perdidas T4 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: De volta ao Alasca, a atitude arriscada de Dave com a máquina de lavagem é desastrosa. Antes do esforço final para fechar a temporada, um membro considera avançar mais cedo.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Este é o teste final de sobrevivência do mais capaz. O que acontece quando coloca um homem e uma mulher nus numa das zonas mais remotas do mundo?

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T7 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Dois sobreviventes são postos à prova nas montanhas rochosas do Colorado. Enfrentam saraivada e condições hipotérmicas durante o seu desafio de 21 dias.

programme.title: Texas Metal T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Um cliente antigo quer melhorar um Ford Ranger de 68 para ser quase perfeito. A equipa cria um novo chassis personalizado, um interior artesanal e troca o motor Coyote 5.0.

programme.title: Texas Metal T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O Impala de 96 surpreende os rapazes quando descobrem que é um impostor. A equipa melhora-o com estruturas de carroçaria personalizadas, substrutura traseira e interior artesanal.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Quais são os processos de produção por detrás das máquinas a pressão e das colmeias?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T22 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano analisados ao microscópio para descobrirmos como os sensores de movimento e os capacetes de mergulho são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T22 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano analisados ao microscópio para descobrirmos como são feitos os candeeiros de couro cru e as máquinas de ressonância magnética.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T16 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: O concessionário de automóveis Mike Brewer e o talentoso mecânico Ant Anstead vão numa missão para encontrar e restaurar carros icónicos que depois vendem na loja, em Los Angeles.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T16 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Mike e Ant recordam a aventura americana. Antes de regressarem ao Reino Unido, deixam a oficina e procuram o que precisam no trabalho de meia década.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro: Minas Perdidas T2 - Ep. 6

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 86
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 91
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 52
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.desc: Uma garota comum se muda para um apartamento de uma família rica, cada uma com sérios problemas psicológicos e obsessões. Eles serão capazes de curar um ao outro?.

programme.title: Walter Trout Band - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: H. Silver, M. Waters, D. Gillespie - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: New Cool Collective - Melkweg, Amsterdam
programme.desc: New Cool Collective is one of the foremost Dutch jazz ensembles. Pioneering new blends of music styles since 1993, NCC has performed in various formations, from small combos to larger ensembles and even big bands! The ensemble’s high energy is cut out for the dance floors, as dance, Latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo all meet in a jazzy mix.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Nasheet Waits - K-Kelli Sketch
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. - Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: Fannie Mae
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Basin Street Blues
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Calypso
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Montreux
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Django Memories
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: The legendary American crooner
programme.desc: His charisma and impeccable phrasing placed him way ahead of the game: ‘The Voice’, Frank Sinatra. The legendary American crooner, who sang swing, jazz, and traditional pop, became one of the most popular and influential musical artists of the 20th century.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals.

programme.title: Portrait: Torino Jazz Festival
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Free Jazz in Kongressaal Munich: Cecil Taylor
programme.desc: In the midst of the blossoming of the free-jazz scene, pianist Cecil Taylor (1929) probably represented the non-jazz aspect of the movement better than anyone else. Many of the innovations of the 1960s were pioneered by his records. His fusion of exuberance and atonality was particularly influential.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock - Sly
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Michel Camilo: The Soloist on Steinway
programme.desc: Well-known for his exuberant style and intimate familiarity with a vast range of jazz and Latin idioms, Michel Camilo has always had a sixth sense for musical adventure. Camilo was one of the most stimulating jazz pianists to emerge in the mid- to late '80s.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Stranger than Paranoia
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: Long Tall Dex: Dexter Gordon Live in '63 And '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64 features three concerts filmed in 1963 and 1964 in Holland, Switzerland and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Filmed while Dexter was living in Europe, these shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano) and jazz classics ‘Blues Walk’, ‘A Night In Tunisia’, ‘Body And Soul’ and others.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: John Lewis: Piano Solo
programme.desc: Pianist John Lewis, co-founder and long-time leader of the legendary Modern Jazz Quartet, wrote jazz history with that band. His ability to blend classical forms with jazz improvisations singled him out as a unique artist, who was capable of transcending every musical barrier. When the Modern Jazz Quartet retired, John Lewis continued to work with other musicians and as a solo pianist.

programme.title: In pursuit of the 27th man
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: Joe Turner - Jazz Marmalade
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade’, shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big’ Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life.

programme.title: Crying Time
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Chick Corea And Gary Burton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Oekraïne
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague.

programme.title: Richard Bona - Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz à Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was the wonderful Richard Bona. He conquered the world with his bass and voice a long time ago.

programme.title: Mont Saint-Michel: Steve Grossman And Peter King
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel. Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between saxophone heavyweights Peter King and Steve Grossman. These experienced musicians’ trip to the bay amounts to much more than a social call. The quintet, which is rounded out by bass player Duylinh N'Guyen, drummer Stéphane Huchard and pianist Alain Jean-Marie, delivers an amazing show.

programme.title: Live in France: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: Jimmy Smith: Live in '69 boasts an incredible 90-minute concert from 1969 filmed in Paris. Working in his classic trio format with longtime guitarist Eddie McFadden and drummer Charlie Crosby, Jimmy shows why he is still the uncontested king of the jazz organ.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson And Kenny G
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Lucky Chops - Live at BIRD
programme.desc: The NYC band Lucky Chops rose to fame when a video of their performance at a subway station went viral on YouTube in 2015. Since then, the energetic quintet has been entertaining audiences all over the world. The band was formed in 2006, when trumpeter Joshua Gawel, saxophonist Daro Behroozi, trombonist Josh Holcomb, tubist Raphael Buyo, and drummer Charles Sams, met during their education at Fiorello H.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Dee Dee Bridgewater
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: 'Round Midnight
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the 'young lions' of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions.

programme.title: The Three Marias
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Badbadnotgood
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Peter Beets And Friends - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: Pianist Peter Beets and the Henk Meutgeert New Jazz Orchestra performed at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam on April 22, 2019. French singer Camille Bertault made a special guest appearance. In 2018, the New Jazz Orchestra was founded by two veterans of Dutch jazz: pianist Peter Beets and arranger Henk Meutgeert. This new big band consists of top tier young jazz talents from the Netherlands.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks And Company - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Libérica Arrels
programme.desc: Having played in New York with jazz icons Dave Liebman, Eliot Zigmund, Ari Hoenig, and Chris Cheek, Catalan bass player Manel Fortià now returns to his roots to reinvent traditional Catalan repertoire. Manel Fortià teams up with Antonia Lizana (saxophones), Pere Martínez (vocals), Max Villavecchia (piano), and Raphael Pannier (drums) to form ‘Libérica’, reimagining Catalan music and Flamenco through the eyes of a New York jazz musician.

programme.title: Christian Scott - The Centennial Trilogy
programme.desc: In just a few years, young trumpet player Christian Scott has become synonymous with a new jazz generation. He shakes up the conventions of jazz by taking the genre to new horizons and reaching a wider audience. No doubt, at 33 years old, Christian Scott is already forging his own path. After each record release, he seems even more determined to challenge the rules of jazz with his own avant-garde style.

programme.desc: Tempo para relaxar e descontrair com sons e imagens da natureza que acalmam e transmitem uma sensação de tranquilidade. Pode ser um bom momento para adormecer ou simplesmente contemplar e descansar.

programme.title: A l'origine
programme.desc: La ville de Jérusalem en Israël regorge de trésors archéologiques. Le mur des lamentations, le Kotel, est l’un des derniers vestiges de l’enceinte du Second Temple de Jérusalem détruit en l’an 70 par les Romains. Mais sous la surface de l’esplanade du Kotel, se cachent plus de 450 mètres de tunnels. Une visite exceptionnelle en compagnie de Gil Perez dans les coulisses de la vie juive de cette époque. Avec Gil Perez

Lorsqu'il est victime d'un accident, elle découvre que l'entreprise familiale est ruinée. Canada. programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Ellen, une femme étouffée par la morale de son époque, est hantée par des rêves d’un vampire. Son mari, Thomas, part en Transylvanie pour vendre un château au Comte Orlok, un vampire qui s’avère fasciné par Ellen. Orlok quitte la Transylvanie pour Wisborg, où il s’installe en face de la maison des Hutter. Ellen se lie à Orlok et l’invite chez elle. Un lieu qui le conduira à sa perte au côté d'Ellen...

programme.title: Averroès And Rosa Parks
programme.desc: Averroès et Rosa Parks : deux unités de l’hôpital Esquirol, qui relèvent - comme l’Adamant - du Pôle psychiatrique Paris-Centre. Des entretiens individuels aux réunions “soignants-soignés”, le cinéaste s’attache à montrer une certaine psychiatrie qui s’efforce encore d’accueillir et de réhabiliter la parole des patients. Peu à peu, chacun d’eux entrouvre la porte de son univers.

programme.title: Le Paris de Modigliani
programme.desc: Au tournant du XXe siècle jusqu’à la première guerre mondiale, l’insouciance dans la capitale est reine. Les progrès techniques progressent, les revendications ouvrières commencent à être satisfaites, les Parisiens s’amusent et la création artistique foisonne… Il faut dire que depuis l’Exposition Universelle de 1900, la capitale est devenue la « Ville lumière de la culture ».
